topics.subject: 中文
topics.title: 常用字與標點
topics.description: P1 中文・常用字與標點課程任務

questions.prompt: 常用字與標點｜第1題：「我今天上學。」句末的標點是甚麼？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「句號」：陳述一句完整意思後使用的標點。

questions.prompt: 常用字與標點｜第2題：「媽媽，早晨！」中間的標點是甚麼？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「逗號」：把一句話中停頓的部分分開。

questions.prompt: 常用字與標點｜第3題：「你喜歡故事書嗎？」句末的標點是甚麼？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「問號」：表示提出問題的標點。

questions.prompt: 常用字與標點｜第4題：「小明在操場跑步」屬於甚麼？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「完整句子」：有清楚的人物和意思的句子。

questions.prompt: 常用字與標點｜第5題：看圖寫句時，先要找出圖中的甚麼？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「人物」：看圖寫句時先觀察圖中的人。

questions.prompt: 常用字與標點｜第6題：「小欣畫畫」中小欣正在做甚麼？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「動作」：說明人物正在做甚麼。

questions.prompt: 常用字與標點｜第7題：「在課室讀書」中的課室是甚麼？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「地點」：指出事情發生的位置。

questions.prompt: 常用字與標點｜第8題：新年時家人拜年、派利是的節日是甚麼？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「春節」：家人團聚和拜年的傳統節日。

questions.prompt: 常用字與標點｜第9題：一家人賞月、吃月餅的節日是甚麼？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「中秋節」：賞月和吃月餅的傳統節日。

questions.prompt: 常用字與標點｜第10題：見到老師說「早晨」表現了甚麼？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「禮貌」：見到老師主動問好的態度。

questions.prompt: 常用字與標點｜第11題：同學跌倒時扶他起來表現甚麼？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「友愛」：願意幫助同學的態度。

questions.prompt: 常用字與標點｜第12題：別人說話時不插嘴表現甚麼？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「尊重」：耐心聆聽別人說話的態度。

questions.prompt: 常用字與標點｜第13題：把紅球和藍球放在一起看顏色不同是甚麼思考方法？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「比較」：找出兩件物品相同或不同的地方。

questions.prompt: 常用字與標點｜第14題：把水果和文具分開放是甚麼思考方法？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「分類」：按共同特徵把物品分組。

questions.prompt: 常用字與標點｜第15題：想知道「蘋果」怎樣寫，可使用甚麼工具？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「圖畫字典」：利用圖片查找字詞的工具。

questions.prompt: High-frequency Words and Phonics｜Choose the correct verb: “She ___ to school every day.”
questions.explanation: She is third-person singular, so the present simple verb is walks.

questions.prompt: High-frequency Words and Phonics｜Choose the opposite of “ancient”.
questions.explanation: Modern is the opposite of ancient.

questions.prompt: High-frequency Words and Phonics｜Which connector shows a reason?
questions.explanation: Because introduces a reason.

questions.prompt: High-frequency Words and Phonics｜Choose the best modal verb: “You ___ wear a helmet when cycling.”
questions.explanation: Should is used to give advice.

questions.prompt: High-frequency Words and Phonics｜Which sentence is in the past tense?
questions.explanation: Visited is the regular past tense form.

questions.prompt: High-frequency Words and Phonics｜What is the main purpose of a topic sentence?
options: To state the main idea of a paragraph
questions.explanation: A topic sentence states a paragraph’s main idea.

questions.prompt: High-frequency Words and Phonics｜Choose the correct passive form: “The cake ___ by Tom.”
questions.explanation: The passive voice uses be + past participle.

questions.prompt: High-frequency Words and Phonics｜Which word is a noun?
questions.explanation: Decision names a thing or idea.

questions.prompt: High-frequency Words and Phonics｜Choose the correct conditional: “If it rains, we ___ inside.”
questions.explanation: The first conditional uses present simple plus will.

questions.prompt: High-frequency Words and Phonics｜What should a formal email include?
options: A clear subject, greeting, purpose and closing
questions.explanation: Formal emails need a clear structure and suitable register.

questions.prompt: Present Continuous｜第2題：Arrange the words to make a correct sentence.

questions.prompt: Present Continuous｜第3題：Arrange the words to make a correct sentence.
questions.explanation: Use She + is + verb-ing.

questions.prompt: Present Continuous｜第4題：Arrange the words to make a correct sentence.
questions.explanation: Use I + like + noun to state a preference.

questions.prompt: Present Continuous｜第5題：Arrange the words to make a correct sentence.
questions.explanation: Went is the past tense of go.

questions.prompt: Present Continuous｜第6題：Arrange the words to make a correct sentence.
questions.explanation: The subject comes before the be verb and adjective.

questions.prompt: Past Continuous｜Choose the correct verb: “She ___ to school every day.”
questions.explanation: She is third-person singular, so the present simple verb is walks.

questions.prompt: Past Continuous｜Choose the opposite of “ancient”.
questions.explanation: Modern is the opposite of ancient.

questions.prompt: Past Continuous｜Which connector shows a reason?
questions.explanation: Because introduces a reason.

questions.prompt: Past Continuous｜Choose the best modal verb: “You ___ wear a helmet when cycling.”
questions.explanation: Should is used to give advice.

questions.prompt: Past Continuous｜Which sentence is in the past tense?
questions.explanation: Visited is the regular past tense form.

questions.prompt: Past Continuous｜What is the main purpose of a topic sentence?
options: To state the main idea of a paragraph
questions.explanation: A topic sentence states a paragraph’s main idea.

questions.prompt: Past Continuous｜Choose the correct passive form: “The cake ___ by Tom.”
questions.explanation: The passive voice uses be + past participle.

questions.prompt: Past Continuous｜Which word is a noun?
questions.explanation: Decision names a thing or idea.

questions.prompt: Past Continuous｜Choose the correct conditional: “If it rains, we ___ inside.”
questions.explanation: The first conditional uses present simple plus will.

questions.prompt: Past Continuous｜What should a formal email include?
options: A clear subject, greeting, purpose and closing
questions.explanation: Formal emails need a clear structure and suitable register.

questions.prompt: Comparatives Superlatives and Connectors｜第6題：Arrange the words to make a correct sentence.

questions.prompt: Comparatives Superlatives and Connectors｜第7題：Arrange the words to make a correct sentence.
questions.explanation: Use will + base verb for the future.

questions.prompt: Comparatives Superlatives and Connectors｜第8題：Arrange the words to make a correct sentence.
questions.explanation: Use should + base verb for advice.

questions.prompt: Comparatives Superlatives and Connectors｜第9題：Arrange the words to make a correct sentence.
questions.explanation: Use are + verb-ing with they.

questions.prompt: Comparatives Superlatives and Connectors｜第10題：Arrange the words to make a correct sentence.
questions.explanation: A singular subject takes is.

topics.title: 世說新語與閱讀策略
topics.description: P6 中文・世說新語與閱讀策略課程任務

questions.prompt: 世說新語與閱讀策略｜第1題：先看標題猜想文章內容是甚麼策略？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「預測」：閱讀前根據題目和資料猜想內容。

questions.prompt: 世說新語與閱讀策略｜第2題：讀到不明白地方時問「作者為何這樣說？」是甚麼策略？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「提問」：閱讀時主動提出問題的策略。

questions.prompt: 世說新語與閱讀策略｜第3題：遇到生字時查字典以明白意思是甚麼策略？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「澄清」：查找資料以弄清不明白內容的策略。

questions.prompt: 世說新語與閱讀策略｜第4題：把一段內容濃縮成兩句重點是甚麼策略？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「摘要」：用精簡文字概括重點的策略。

questions.prompt: 世說新語與閱讀策略｜第5題：寫社區服務經歷並談感受的寫法叫甚麼？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「夾敍夾議」：敍述事情同時發表看法的寫法。

questions.prompt: 世說新語與閱讀策略｜第6題：想向校長提出增設飲水機可寫甚麼？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「建議書」：就問題提出改善方法的實用文。

questions.prompt: 世說新語與閱讀策略｜第7題：在畢業禮向全級同學說話可寫甚麼？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「演講辭」：向聽眾發表講話的文字。

questions.prompt: 世說新語與閱讀策略｜第8題：主動照顧有需要的人符合哪個價值？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「仁」：關愛他人的文化價值。

questions.prompt: 世說新語與閱讀策略｜第9題：看見不公平的事願意挺身而出符合哪個價值？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「義」：做合宜和正當事情的文化價值。

questions.prompt: 世說新語與閱讀策略｜第10題：排隊守秩序符合哪個價值？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「禮」：尊重規範和他人的文化價值。

questions.prompt: 世說新語與閱讀策略｜第11題：先分析資料才下決定符合哪個價值？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「智」：明辨是非和善用知識的文化價值。

questions.prompt: 世說新語與閱讀策略｜第12題：答應同學的事努力做到符合哪個價值？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「信」：誠實守信用的文化價值。

questions.prompt: 世說新語與閱讀策略｜第13題：向幫助過自己的人說謝謝表現甚麼？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「感恩」：珍惜別人付出的態度。

questions.prompt: 世說新語與閱讀策略｜第14題：參與社區清潔活動表現甚麼？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「社會責任」：關心社會並付諸行動的態度。

questions.prompt: 世說新語與閱讀策略｜第15題：為社區問題訪問居民和分析結果叫甚麼？
questions.explanation: 正確答案是「專題研習」：獨立搜集資料和整理成果的學習方式。

questions.prompt: 實用文與演講辭｜閱讀篇章「給校長的建議」：文中的主角是誰？
questions.explanation: 文中一開始便寫到主角是六年級同學。
questions.passageText: 六年級同學發現操場旁的飲水機常常排長龍。他們訪問不同班別後，建議學校在另一邊加設飲水機，並在繁忙時間安排學生義工提醒大家排隊。

questions.prompt: 實用文與演講辭｜閱讀篇章「給校長的建議」：事情主要發生在哪裏？
questions.explanation: 篇章交代事情主要發生在操場旁。
questions.passageText: 六年級同學發現操場旁的飲水機常常排長龍。他們訪問不同班別後，建議學校在另一邊加設飲水機，並在繁忙時間安排學生義工提醒大家排隊。

questions.prompt: 實用文與演講辭｜閱讀篇章「給校長的建議」：主角做了甚麼？
options: 訪問不同班別並提出建議
拿出泛黃的家書講述往事

questions.prompt: 統計抽樣與離差｜第1題：抽樣調查中，哪一項有助提升代表性？

questions.promptEn: Statistics Sampling and Dispersion | Question 1: Which practice improves representativeness in a sample survey?

questions.prompt: 統計抽樣與離差｜第2題：若要減少抽樣誤差，哪個做法較合適？
questions.explanation: 較大的樣本通常可減少抽樣誤差。
questions.promptEn: Statistics Sampling and Dispersion | Question 2: Which practice can reduce sampling error?
questions.explanationEn: A larger sample generally reduces sampling error.

questions.prompt: 統計抽樣與離差｜第3題：要比較不同年級的意見，哪種抽樣較合適？
questions.explanation: 分層抽樣能讓各年級都有代表。
questions.promptEn: Statistics Sampling and Dispersion | Question 3: Which sampling method suits comparing different year groups?
questions.explanationEn: Stratified sampling gives each year group representation.

questions.prompt: 統計抽樣與離差｜第4題：問卷問題應避免甚麼？
questions.explanation: 引導性措辭會影響受訪者的回答。
questions.promptEn: Statistics Sampling and Dispersion | Question 4: What should a survey question avoid?

questions.prompt: 統計抽樣與離差｜第5題：調查結果要代表全校，樣本應包括甚麼？
questions.explanation: 樣本應涵蓋目標群體的不同類別。
questions.promptEn: Statistics Sampling and Dispersion | Question 5: To represent the whole school, what should a sample include?
questions.explanationEn: A sample should cover different groups in the target population.

questions.prompt: 統計抽樣與離差｜第6題：未回覆問卷的情況稱為甚麼？
questions.explanation: 無回應可能造成調查偏差。

questions.prompt: 統計抽樣與離差｜第7題：重複調查時最應保持甚麼？
questions.explanation: 一致程序有助比較不同調查結果。
questions.promptEn: Statistics Sampling and Dispersion | Question 7: What should be kept consistent in a repeated survey?

questions.prompt: 統計抽樣與離差｜第8題：統計圖表標題的主要作用是甚麼？
questions.explanation: 標題讓讀者知道圖表展示甚麼資料。
questions.promptEn: Statistics Sampling and Dispersion | Question 8: What is the main purpose of a graph title?
questions.explanationEn: A title tells readers what data a graph shows.

questions.prompt: 統計抽樣與離差｜第9題：有代表性的樣本應接近甚麼？
questions.explanation: 代表性樣本的特徵應接近目標群體。
questions.promptEn: Statistics Sampling and Dispersion | Question 9: What should a representative sample resemble?
questions.explanationEn: A representative sample resembles the target population.

questions.prompt: 統計抽樣與離差｜第10題：分析數據時，不應做甚麼？
questions.explanation: 選擇性刪除資料會扭曲結論。

questions.explanationEn: Selective deletion of data can distort conclusions.
